index.title: Pixel Home: cozy queue-sorting puzzles
index.description: Pixel Home is a cozy pixel-art puzzle about getting everyone home. 100 gardens in ten worlds, a fresh daily puzzle, no ads and no timers.
index.tagline: Sort the colors, mind the queue and get every pip home. A cozy pixel-art puzzle for iPhone and iPad.
index.badge: Coming soon to the App Store
index.shotTitle: The Pixel Home title screen with lives, the shop, gifts and postcards
index.shotBrookside: A Brookside garden: two homes, their orders and the Flow Line
index.shotGlowcave: A Glowcave garden with a color gate
index.shotPostcards: Pixel Postcards revealed one piece per cleared level
index.shotGifts: The daily gift and three daily missions
index.how1: Little critters called pips wait in their burrows. Tap one to send it out. If its home is ready, it walks straight there. If not, it waits in the Flow Line, and the line moves strictly first in, first out.
index.how2: Homes take one color at a time and the line is short, so the order you choose is the whole puzzle. Plan it, keep the line moving and fill every home.
index.worlds: From the Meadow to the Starlit Summit. New ideas arrive gently: switches, Nooks where a pip can rest, color gates, and a Stretch that lends one more slot.
index.daily: The Daily Flow is a new garden each day, the same for every player, with its own Game Center leaderboard.
index.pace: No ads and no level timers. Undo, hints and rewinding to the last solvable moment are always free.
index.lives: A life is used only when you give up a jammed attempt at a new level. Replays, Challenge runs and the Daily Flow never cost one.
index.collect: Up to three stars per garden, Pixel Postcards revealed piece by piece, a daily gift, daily missions and new garden looks.
index.devices: Optional Sign in with Apple keeps your garden in your own iCloud. Game Center is there if you want it. Playing as a guest is complete.
index.freeTitle: Free to play, nothing to watch
index.free1: Pixel Home is free and has no advertising. Optional in-app purchases offer extra lives, 24 hours of unlimited lives and Stretch boosters; the daily gift, missions and awards give the same things for free.
index.free2: The game collects no data. Read the privacy policy, or visit support if you need a hand.

support.title: Pixel Home support
support.description: Help with Pixel Home: lives, purchases, saving progress, Game Center and how to get in touch.
support.heading: Support
support.lead: Answers to the common questions, and how to reach us.
support.contact: Tell us what happened, which device and iOS version you use, and the version shown at the bottom of the game's Settings.
support.lives: You have five lives, and one comes back every 30 minutes. A life is used only when an attempt at a level you haven't cleared jams and you then restart or leave it. Undo, hints, rewind, replays of cleared levels, Challenge runs and the Daily Flow never cost a life.
support.stuck: Use Hint for the next useful move. If the flow jams, Rewind takes you back to the last position that can still be solved. Both are free and unlimited.
support.purchase1: Close and reopen the game. A purchase that was interrupted is delivered when the game starts.
support.purchase2: Open the shop and tap Restore purchases. Life packs, unlimited lives and boosters are used up when bought, so there is nothing to restore later, but this collects anything still waiting.
support.purchase3: With Ask to Buy, the items arrive once the purchase is approved.
support.purchase4: For refunds, use reportaproblem.apple.com. Purchases are handled by Apple.
support.progressTitle: Keeping progress on a new device
support.progress1: Open your profile (the gardener badge on the title screen) and choose Sign in with Apple. Your progress is then saved to your own iCloud and follows you to any iPhone or iPad signed in to the same Apple Account with iCloud turned on. Syncing can take up to a minute.
support.progress2: The five regenerating lives belong to each device. Bought and earned lives travel with your save.
support.gameCenter: Game Center is optional. Nothing happens until you tap Sign in to Game Center in your profile. If that says to sign in in the Settings app, open Settings, then Game Center, and sign in there first.
support.delete: In your profile, Delete account data removes the cloud save linked to your Apple Account and signs you out. Deleting the app removes your progress and settings from the device. Your lives and what your purchases granted are kept in the iOS Keychain, so they are still there if you install the game again. To stop using Sign in with Apple with Pixel Home, open the Settings app, tap your name, then Sign in with Apple.

privacy.title: Pixel Home privacy policy
privacy.description: Pixel Home collects no data: no accounts on our side, no analytics, no advertising and no tracking.
privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.summary: Pixel Home does not collect any data about you. It has no analytics, no advertising, no tracking and no third-party software kits, and we run no servers for it.
privacy.device: Your progress and settings are stored on your device. Your lives, the record of what your purchases granted and your sign-in are kept in the iOS Keychain on your device, where they can remain after the game is deleted, so that they are still there if you install it again. None of this is sent to us.
privacy.signIn: You can play as a guest. If you choose to sign in, the game asks Apple only for your name, never your email address. Apple gives the game an identifier for your account. It is kept on your device and used to label your save in your own iCloud storage. We have no server, so neither the identifier nor your name ever reaches us.
privacy.icloud: When you are signed in, your progress is saved to your own iCloud key-value storage so it can follow you to your other devices. That storage belongs to your Apple Account. We cannot read it. Apple's handling of it is covered by Apple's privacy policy.
privacy.gameCenter: If you choose to sign in to Game Center, your scores and achievements are sent to Apple's Game Center under your Game Center profile. The game does not start Game Center until you ask for it.
privacy.purchases: In-app purchases are processed by Apple. We never see your payment details.
privacy.children: Because the game collects no data from anyone, it collects none from children.
privacy.site: This site is hosted on GitHub Pages. It uses no cookies and no analytics of its own. GitHub may log technical information such as IP addresses to operate the service, as described in the GitHub privacy statement.
privacy.changes: If this policy changes, the new version will be published on this page with a new effective date.
privacy.language: This policy is published in several languages for convenience. If the versions differ, the English version applies.
privacy.contact: Questions about this policy can be sent to {email}.
